agent_summary: Angiopoietin-2, glycocalyx shedding (syndecan-1, hyaluronan, heparan sulfate) and VEGF/sFlt-1 have never been measured in dogs with babesiosis (PubMed and local corpus, 2026-11-12). All three have strong human severity evidence: malaria cohorts plus sepsis meta-analyses. All three also have canine assays already used in canine sepsis or critical care, so they are true gaps. Soluble adhesion molecules are not a gap: CB004 (Zagreb, B. canis) compared sICAM-1 and sVCAM-1 between complicated and uncomplicated dogs, and only VCAM-1 differed at admission. Surprise: the canine Ang-2 data come from validated cross-reactive human ELISAs, and Ang-2 was higher in septic non-survivors. But ANGPT2 itself is not among the DS06 genes (only ANGPT1 and TEK), and no F2 protein is a DS07 master protein.

mechanisms.human_direction: Ang-2 and the Ang-2/Ang-1 ratio are higher in severe and fatal malaria (falciparum, knowlesi, vivax) and in sepsis non-survivors and sepsis AKI. Ang-1 is lower.
cb_rejected: No CB note or CB text hit for angiopoietin, Ang-2, ANGPT2, Tie-2 or TEK

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has ANGPT1 (ENSCAFG00000000693) and TEK (ENSCAFG00000001713). These are whole-blood gene expression, not circulating protein. ANGPT2 is not among the DS06 genes. No DS07 master protein. Not in DS02. Plasma Ang-2 itself would need stored samples (validated human ELISA).
mechanisms.notes: A human Ang-2 ELISA was validated for canine plasma (Ang-1 ELISA failed). In canine SIRS/sepsis, Ang-2 was higher in non-survivors. Ang-2 has been measured in canine leishmaniosis, but never in babesiosis. The DS06 match is partial (receptor and Ang-1 only), and Ang-2 is stored in endothelial Weibel-Palade bodies, so blood RNA is a weak proxy.

mechanisms.human_direction: Higher urinary glycosaminoglycans and plasma syndecan-1 go with severe and fatal falciparum malaria, and with severity in vivax and knowlesi malaria. A sepsis meta-analysis links syndecan-1 to complications and mortality.
cb_rejected: CB223: 'glycocalyx' occurs only in the reviewer's text. The study measured total serum chondroitin sulfates by a colourimetric method (connective-tissue GAG), not glycocalyx fragments, with 12 infected vs 10 healthy dogs and no severity contrast.

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has SDC1 (ENSCAFG00000003833) and HPSE (ENSCAFG00000009094). These are whole-blood gene expression, not shed circulating ectodomain. No DS07 master protein. Not in DS02. Plasma syndecan-1, HA or HS would need stored samples.
mechanisms.notes: Canine syndecan-1, hyaluronan and heparan sulfate ELISAs have been used in trauma, haemorrhage models, anaesthesia (urinary syndecan-1, https://doi.org/10.1111/jvim.17121) and sepsis or critical illness (HA). No formal canine analytical validation was found, so graded used_in_dogs. Hyaluronan is the same molecule in all species. Blood RNA for SDC1 does not reflect endothelial shedding.

mechanisms.mechanism: Soluble endothelial adhesion molecules (ICAM-1, VCAM-1, E-selectin)
mechanisms.human_direction: sICAM-1 (and sVCAM-1, sE-selectin) are higher in cerebral and severe malaria and go with AKI and mortality in paediatric severe malaria. In knowlesi malaria they correlate with endothelial markers.

cb_confirmed.what: Canine ELISA for sICAM-1 and sVCAM-1 in 30 dogs with B. canis (11 complicated vs 19 uncomplicated) plus 10 controls. At admission sVCAM-1 was higher in complicated dogs (p=0.004). sICAM-1 did not differ by severity; it was higher at admission than at day 6.
Canine ELISA for sICAM-1 in 12 dogs with B. canis vs 10 healthy dogs, before and 3 days after treatment. Higher than controls.
ELISA for sICAM-1 in 12 dogs before and 6 days after imidocarb. Lower than healthy dogs. Same Zagreb group as CB446 (possible overlap; not in cohorts.json).

VCAM-1 immunohistochemistry of the lung in fatal B. rossi cases vs control lungs. Endothelial staining was similar to controls; intravascular leukocytes were positive. Tissue, not a severity contrast.

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has ICAM1 (ENSCAFG00000031460). This is whole-blood gene expression (leukocyte ICAM-1), not soluble endothelial protein. VCAM1 and SELE are not in DS06. No DS07 master protein. Not in DS02.
mechanisms.notes: One severity-tested unit (CB004, 11 vs 19 dogs): only sVCAM-1 at admission was significant. The sICAM-1 direction against controls conflicts between CB384 (lower) and CB446 (higher). No study of sE-selectin in canine babesiosis was found; it remains unmeasured but is folded into this row. Graded validated because canine-specific ELISA kits were used. CB384 has no DOI in the corpus.

mechanisms.human_direction: sFlt-1 (soluble VEGFR-1) is higher in sepsis with ARDS and in non-survivors (a systematic review and meta-analysis supports prognostic value). VEGF results in malaria are mixed: higher in severe vivax malaria, but proposed as protective in cerebral malaria.
cb_rejected: CB122: serum extracellular-vesicle proteomics (15 B. canis vs 15 healthy dogs). VEGF/VEGFR appears only as an enrichment annotation of a pathway; VEGF and sFlt-1 were not quantified and there was no severity contrast

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has VEGFA (ENSCAFG00000001938) and FLT1 (ENSCAFG00000006701). These are whole-blood gene expression; the soluble sFlt-1 splice form is not separable without isoform-level analysis. No DS07 master protein. Not in DS02. Plasma VEGF would need stored samples.
mechanisms.notes: The 'validated' grade applies to VEGF only: an ELISA was validated for canine VEGF, and VEGF was higher in septic and non-surviving dogs. No canine sFlt-1 measurement was found. The human grade rests mostly on sepsis sFlt-1; the malaria VEGF evidence is small and inconsistent.
